subject: general
question: Prayansh starts from point A and drives 34 km towards the north. He then takes a left turn, drives 41 km, turns left and drives 56 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 63 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 22 km and stops at point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only, unless specified.)
solution:
Given:

Prayansh starts from A and drives 34 km North.

He turns left → 41 km West.

He turns left → 56 km South.

He turns left → 63 km East.

He takes a final left turn → 22 km North and reaches P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a275cf1616259f562d77a8bd3ea6ff6aaed48836bc259115f14afdd6bba4d442.png] 

So, To reach A from P → move 22 km West.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4.**
